specific_numerical_failure.mechanism: Cancellation in near-parallel edge/triangle determinant arithmetic. Tiny nonzero determinants pass absolute 1e-25 or !=0 predicates; barycentric/segment ratios appear inside bounds but do not reconstruct the same world point. Unchecked return-zero overrides valid positive-distance candidates.
specific_numerical_failure.evidence_strength: All three failed code paths and their zero returns are directly observed. Four other anonymous executions independently expose/recover this same class of false hit, including out-of-face barycentrics, singular solve and centimetre-scale reconstruction residuals. The cause is not inferred from final text alone.
specific_numerical_failure.not_a_new_requirement: Consumers were not required to provide formal certificates; actual incorrect geometric results fail the ordinary task contract. Successful fixed-task full-surface calculations pass without extra universal robustness proof.
